description: Set a candidate's GLOBAL DEMOGRAPHIC DIALS in a primary — how many points to shift them among a voter group across the whole district/state. levers = { uniform, college, immig, highHome, lowHome, hiUnemp } in…

candidate_id.description: The candidate id from the field roster (e.g. P1, or a registry/custom id).

levers.description: Points to shift this candidate per voter group, at full demographic intensity. Any omitted axis = 0. Each clamped to ±30.

party.description: Which party's primary field. For a top-two (nonpartisan) primary, pass D as the storage bucket.

workspace_scope.description: Optional workspace for THIS call: use an exact personal/team ID from list_workspaces. Repeat on each call; it does not change the connection default. Must agree with MCP metadata and the effective HTTP workspace selector (header, otherwise connector URL). OAuth connections can only use their granted workspace. Membership and campaign permissions still apply.

name: set_primary_demo_levers
